text:
alex: Heads-up: in prod we saw exporter 'client connection closed' spikes when fallback from OTLP/gRPC to HTTP happens during ingest bursts. Any preferences for retry/backoff defaults? Causing backpressure to the traces pipeline.

maria: Which cluster/stack? Dedicated or hosted? Can you paste the exporter config? :eyes:

alex: It's hosted, route=eu-west-1. Exporter snippet:```json
{
  "exporter": "otlp",
  "transport": "grpc",
  "fallback_transport": "http/protobuf",
  "retry": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_attempts": 3,
    "base_delay_ms": 100,
    "max_delay_ms": 2000,
    "jitter": "full"
  },
  "hedging": {
    "enabled": false,
    "hedge_delay_ms": 50
  },
  "grpc_deadline_ms": 10000,
  "http_timeout_ms": 8000
}
```

sam: We saw similar flaps in staging. Ops suggestions: enable hedging for short tails (helps p99), switch to exponential backoff w/ full jitter (per AWS blog), and increase gRPC deadline to 20s; HTTP timeout to ~15s. Also include an idempotency header for POSTs so retries are safe.

jen: If fallback flips frequently you get thundering retries. Consider: 1) fast health probe for transport (probe every 5s, failure threshold 3) 2) a transient circuit breaker: if HTTP errors >5 in 30s, disable HTTP fallback for 60s and drain queued requests to gRPC-only 3) distinguish 429 vs 5xx: on 429 respect Retry-After and apply longer backoff.

deploy-bot: rollout: exporters/config v2.1 -> staged canary (10%) started by @jen at 1968732125

alex: logs pasted:```
[2026-03-17T14:02:41Z] exporter.go:218: send error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
[2026-03-17T14:02:41Z] exporter.go:220: retry attempt 1 -> backend=http://otlp-backup:4318 status=503
[2026-03-17T14:02:42Z] exporter.go:223: retry attempt 2 -> backend=http://otlp-backup:4318 status=429 Retry-After=2
[2026-03-17T14:02:43Z] exporter.go:226: retry exhausted, dropping batch
```

maria: Can we add per-tenant retry budgets (so noisy tenants don't exhaust global capacity)? e.g. x-retry-budget: tenant-123=5. Also quota-ing at the exporter shim would help.

sam: Agree on tenant budgets. Also instrument exporter attempts with spans/attributes: exporter.attempt, exporter.backend, exporter.error_code, exporter.retry_reason — that'll let us build SLO alerts and surface noisy clients in the console.

jen: I'll prototype remote-config flags to tune base_delay_ms, max_attempts, and hedging per-route/tenant. @alex can you run a canary with base_delay_ms=200 and hedging enabled? We'll watch spans.

alex: Yep, will run a 5% canary now and post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

jen: One more: add metrics for "fallback switches" and a histogram of time-to-first-success after fallback. Those metrics helped us catch a bad proxy change last quarter.

alex: Good call — adding those to the exporter metrics set.

maria: sgtm. if anyone wants to pair on the probe/circuit-breaker implementation I can carve out time this afternoon.

sam: I'll join for 30m at 17:00.

jen: thanks all. I'll open a tiny RFC for the remote-config knobs and CB semantics.
